name: ModConfigEditor
summary: Edit mod configs from minecraft directly, better gui, more efficient
description: ![Itamio Mod Stamp](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/88d017da6c7bc2334797c55c8097522780b9d86e.png) --- ## (Mod Config Visualizer - old name) ### What it does: - Makes it so that you can **edit mod configs in the minecraft game**, no need to edit in notepad or some other things. - Has **auto config detectors**, meaning you dont need to manually specify what mods have which config files (most of the time, sometimes you might need to manually add) - User **friendly add button**, when adding config files, shows a file pick that is already in the config folder, so no annoying process of finding the correct minecraft instance's minecraft/config folder. ### Preview ![Rewritten Mods Display Screen](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cd7e96c2ad674094f8862e642d8c81bfc10a176f.png) ![Auto detect config files](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/088bac8a2a9d5bcd8f7880bb3bcb041297d03ad1.png) ![Edit config in game](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/fa22de7961a83d4571fcd4749217ce5c2a49ea1e.png)
author: Sekai0ni0Itamio
